name: cookies-banner.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/cookies-banner.scss — CookieBanner shadow stylesheet entry
//  (adoptedStyleSheets). Compiles only the cookie-consent banner surface
//  so the banner's styles travel with its component chunk instead of the
//  document entry sheet.
//  Standalone entry — imports the compile-time base chain itself.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../../base/variables';
@import '../../../base/mixins';
@import '../../../base/placeholders';
// NOTE: no _fonts import — the banner @extends %TTL_XS (emitted on use)
// instead of pulling the full ~200-line class ramp.
// NOTE: no _structure import — :root custom properties are emitted once by
// the document app.scss and inherit into shadow roots; re-emitting them
// here would duplicate ~700 lines of tokens per shadow sheet.

@import 'cookies';
